summary: The symmetric-exchange argument, support reductions, maximum-entropy characterization, affine hull, full gauge space, and exact layer counts are correct for every k >= 2. The smallest case k = 2 has layer counts 8, 9, 8 and variance 16/25. The conditional-gamma construction uses the stated normalization without importing complete-composition hypotheses; its total-variance identity and the divergent optimized noise-to-count variance ratio establish the claimed obstruction.
